name: BSC TMM/USDT
rootCause: According to ExVul monitoring, a TMM/USDT reserve manipulation attack occurred on the BSC (BNB Chain), resulting in a loss of approximately 1.665 million USDT. The attacker utilized flash loans from Lista DAO Moolah, Venus, Aave V3, PancakeSwap Vault, and Uniswap PoolManager to manipulate the TMM/USDT trading pair. By burning TMM to a dead address, the attacker reduced the pair's reserve to just 1 TMM, subsequently swapping 850 million TMM for approximately 272 million USDT. After repaying all flash loans, the attacker transferred a net profit of roughly 1.665 million USDT to associated addresses.

On 4 April 2026, the BSC TMM/USDT liquidity pool on BNB Chain was exploited via flash loan-driven reserve manipulation. The attacker burned TMM tokens to a dead address, desynchronized pool reserves, and extracted $1.665M USDT at a skewed price. The pool contract failed to synchronize reserve balances after TMM tokens were burned, allowing attackers to manipulate spot pricing and drain USDT through a flash loan and swap sequence.
